venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 10/3 (MOD Jk; 85/71).** Net sales $9,048 vs target $9,241 (-2.1%). Food $455. Comps $51.85. 318 guests, check avg $28.54. Calm start; DJ OS in at 9pm adjusted well to the crowd; consistent flow; wedding guests stopped in around midnight. Reminders: leave the bar to touch tables in lulls, promote daily activations, check bathrooms. Kitchen: watch the screen to avoid missed tickets. 86: Crown, Jameson, High Life, tonic. No incident. Favorite moment: wedding party joining.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Saturday 10/3 (MOD/Chef KE, DJ; overcast, some rain).** Net sales $10,916 vs target $11,043 (-1.1%). Food $339. Comps $170 / 1.55%. 412 guests, check avg ~$27. Fun, not crazy-busy Saturday with pops ~9:30-10pm; live band brought great energy; small pop after Charmers closed. Kitchen smooth. Low: Hazy IPA. No incident.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 10/3 (AM Evan & Josh; PM Carey & Lucas).** Net sales incl. events $28,468.75 (non-event net $15,828.75 vs target $17,532 = -9.7%; target is for non-event service). Net event sales $12,640 (wedding, 73 guests 5-10pm, all spaces); food incl. events $10,427.05 (non-event food $2,772.05; event food $7,655). DC/AM $1,431.46. Comps $215.71 / 1.37%. 376 guests (Tock), check avg $75.71 (net incl. events/guests). No Garden for general service due to wedding; wait-list guests returned well; down a server; Paige broke $4k sales for the first time. Slower Saturday than usual in kitchen; event team and chefs Josh & Lucas executed a plated dinner smoothly. Form typo on PM sales figure ('$1,4356.98') ignored.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 10/3 (MOD Kyler / Steves).** Total EOD net sales $8,501 vs target $6,874 (+23.7%). Food $720, beverage $7,541, retail $240. Comps $205.10. 240 guests (SevenRooms), check avg $35. Ran at high velocity until 1am with a few lulls in turns 1.5 and 2.5; 7 large parties, 4 solos, 12 investor cocktails; waitlist of mostly 3s/4s. Top sellers: Burner Phone, Rosalie, Native Lion, High Plains Drifter. Manager flagged loss of guest tags (employee-held regular/host context). 2 no-shows. Maintenance: speakers not fixed; Toast broke in first hour.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 10/3 (MOD Julian, Joe, Gianna).** Net sales $13,216 vs target $13,784 (-4.1%). Marquee $9,222; Standing Room $3,993; food $2,093. Comps $429.13. 328 guests, check avg $40.29. Busy Saturday, full house with both rooms open; management split into sections; members, investors and whiskey reps in; hefty waitlist. Kitchen on time. Maintenance: standing room water tap leaking. 86: passion syrup, serrano vodka.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Saturday 10/3 (MOD Josh; overcast/rain).** Total net sales incl. events $9,149.28 vs target $9,702 (-5.7%). Marquee bar $7,582.50; Garden $1,663; food $1,015. Comps $96.22, voids $18. 188 guests, check avg $48.67 (net/guests; form GCA $39.10 / CA $80.56). Slow start, heavy pick-up, then major drop-off; midnight lull with ~4 tables, soft breakdown and cuts; nearby spots also light with rain. Garden picked up ~7pm, cleared by 11. Improve: creative ways to raise check average. Maintenance: curtains.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Rainy by day, humid and warm
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 10/3 (AM Justin & Lex/Shannon; PM Justin & Marcus/Drew/Shannon; rainy).** Net sales $18,000 vs target $13,911 (+29.4%). Municipal AM $4,206; PM $11,480; Sun Club $0 (opening cancelled for rain); Hot Eye $2,314; food $6,794. Comps $354. Guests: OpenTable counts reported as 0 so guest count/check avg left blank. Saturday brunch busier than Friday dinner; Lucas Philharmonic at 7:30 drove pre-show rush; post-show push at 10. Hot Eye slow start then power hours, ran out of mint. 86: mint, frisee, zucchini. Maintenance: Crisalli machine, bar prep hallway leak.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Saturday 10/3 (MOD Julian // Curtis).** Net sales $12,010 vs target $10,000 (+20.1%). Food $1,769. Comps $586.93 ($150 shifties, rest DNL/SND). 279 guests, check avg $43.05. Busy Saturday with a long waitlist; a guest booked an 8-top that was actually 12 but it worked out; some reservation bumps smoothed with drinks. Soundtrack schedule stops at 12:15, needs adjusting. 86: Uwajima Gimlet (yuzu kosho). No incident.
